blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Segmentation-based multi-object tracking (MOT) with foundation video models such as SAM2 offers strong localization quality, yet remains fragile in crowded, real-world scenes.
In detector‑prompted SAM2 pipelines, failures typically arise at three stages of the object lifecycle: (i) erroneous or duplicate track initiation, (ii) memory drift during close interactions, and (iii) unreliable re-identification after long occlusions or re‑entry. These errors corrupt object memory and accumulate over time, making long‑horizon tracking unstable. In this paper, we reframe MOT as a lifecycle memory integrity problem. We present LiAM-SAM, a Lifecycle-Aware Memory (LiAM) framework with targeted mechanisms for each of the three failure modes. At track birth, to prevent faulty or duplicate initiations, we apply contrastive track initiation, which conditions each prompt on existing nearby tracked instances. To preserve memory integrity during strong interactions, we introduce motion‑ and geometry‑grounded memory correction that resolves interaction confusions and suppresses drift. For reliable re‑identification after disappearance, we maintain an adaptive context memory that promotes diverse and trustworthy references as long‑term identity anchors. Finally, similarity aware spatial pruning optionally selects the memory tokens to retain at cross‑attention time, improving efficiency with minimal accuracy loss. LiAM-SAM represents a modular, detector-agnostic, SAM2-based MOT system that achieves state-of-the-art HOTA and IDF1 on the evaluated benchmarks. In association-challenging environments, our ablations show that LiAM improves a detector+SAM2 baseline by +10.5 HOTA, +17.4 AssA, and reduces identity switches by 96%.
blocks.zh:
带有SAM2等基础视频模型的分块式多对象跟踪(MOT)提供了很强的本地化质量,但在拥挤的,现实世界的场景中仍然脆弱.
在探测器-即期SAM2管道中,通常在物体生命周期的三个阶段出现故障:(一) 错误或重复的轨道启动;(二) 近距离相互作用过程中的内存漂移;(三) 长期隔离或重新进入后不可靠的重新识别。 这些错误会腐蚀对象内存并随时间而积累,使得长视距追踪不稳定. 在本文中,我们把MOT重新设定为生命周期记忆完整性问题. 我们提出了LiAM-SAM,这是一个生命周期-智能记忆(LiAM)框架,对三种失败模式中的每一一种都有目标机制. 在田径诞生时,为了防止错误或重复的启动,我们采用对比性田径启动,每个田径启动的条件都是在附近已有的田径启动的情况下进行的。 为了在强烈的相互作用中保持记忆的完整性,我们引入了运动-和几何-基于记忆的校正,以解决相互作用的混乱和抑制漂移。 为了在失踪后可靠地重新确认身份,我们保持一种适应性背景记忆,促进作为长期身份锚点的多样化和可信赖的参考。 最后,类似性感知空间冲刺可选择选择在交叉注意时间保留存储符,以最小的精度损失来提高效率. LiAM-SAM代表一个模块化的、可探测的、基于SAM2的MOT系统,在评估的基准上实现最先进的HOTA和FID1。 在关联挑战环境中,我们的模拟显示,LiAM将探测器+SAM2基线改进为+10.5 HOTA,+17.4 AssA,并将身份开关减少96%.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Multi-object tracking (MOT) is a fundamental computer-vision task that aims to maintain consistent object identities over time, a core requirement for reliable scene understanding in applications such as autonomous driving, robotics, and surveillance. Recent segmentation-driven trackers built on SAM2 [ 20 ] improve localization quality, but they remain brittle in crowded and interaction-heavy scenes where frequent overlaps, occlusions, disappearances, and re-entries amplify identity errors.
blocks.zh: 多对象跟踪(MOT)是一项基本的计算机-视觉任务,旨在随着时间的推移保持一致的物体身份,这是在自主驾驶,机器人,监视等应用中可靠场景理解的核心要求. 以SAM2[20]为基础的近期分化驱动的跟踪器提高了本地化质量,但它们仍然在拥挤和互动性重的场景中坚韧不拔,这些场景经常发生重叠、隔离、失踪和重新进入,扩大了身份错误。

blocks.en: In detector-prompted SAM2 systems, the main failures arise at three stages of the object lifecycle: (1) track initiation , where permissive detections can trigger erroneous or duplicate track births; (2) interaction-time propagation , where close contacts can corrupt object-specific memory updates, causing drift, mask bleeding, and identity swaps; and (3) reappearance , where long occlusions or exit/re-entry events break re-identification when references are obsolete or weakly curated.
blocks.zh: 在探测器催化的SAM2系统中,主要故障发生在物体生命周期的三个阶段:(1) 轨迹启动,允许检测可触发错误或重复的轨迹诞生;(2) 相互作用时间传播,密切接触可腐蚀特定物体的内存更新,造成漂移,面具出血,以及身份交换;(3) 重新出现,长期隔离或退出/重返事件在引用过时或模糊时中断重新识别。

blocks.en: Prior work addresses subsets of this problem, but not the full lifecycle of attention-based memory control. Memory-less trackers such as SORT, ByteTrack, and OC-SORT improve association through motion-consistent updates and low-confidence detection recovery [ 2 , 39 , 3 ] , yet they do not maintain explicit object memory and therefore degrade under long visibility gaps and complex interactions. Attention-based trackers such as TrackFormer and TransTrack introduce persistent track queries [ 17 , 23 ] , but their memory has no explicit mechanism to handle severe overlap. Segmentation-centered works based on SAM/SAM2/SAM3, including MOT solutions MASA, SAM2MOT and SAM3 [ 13 , 11 , 4 ] , provide stronger mask-level representations, while SAM2-Long and SAMURAI improve long-horizon memory handling [ 6 , 33 ] ; however, they do not provide a unified autonomous policy to handle memory corruptions that arise and propagate at the different stages of tracks lifecycle.
blocks.zh: 之前的工作针对的是这个问题的子集,但不是基于注意力的内存控制的整个生命周期. SORT,ByteTrack,OC-SORT等无记忆追踪器通过运动一致的更新和低信心检测恢复[2,39,3]改善关联性,然而它们并没有保持明确的物体内存,因此在长时间的可见性差距和复杂的相互作用下降解. 基于关注的跟踪器如TrackFormer和TransTrack引入了持久性的跟踪查询[17,23],但其内存并没有处理严重重叠的明确机制. 以SAM/SAM2/SAM3为基础的以分块为中心的作品,包括MOT解决方案MASA,SAM2MOT和SAM3[13,11,4],提供了更强的口罩级别表示,而SAM2-Long和SAMURAI则改进了长视内存处理[6,33];然而,它们并没有提供统一的自主政策来处理在轨道生命周期不同阶段出现的并传播的内存腐败.

blocks.en: These observations motivate our view: robust SAM2-based MOT is a memory-integrity problem. In standard SAM2 usage, memory curation is interactive; in MOT, the same decisions must be made autonomously and online under noisy detections and ambiguous interactions. At the same time, memory-attention complexity grows with both the number of tracked objects and the number of stored references, making memory efficiency increasingly important.
blocks.zh: 这些观察激发了我们的观点:强健的SAM2-基于MOT是一个内存集成问题. 在标准SAM2的用法中,内存曲解是交互式的;在MOT中,同样的决定必须在吵闹的检测和模棱两可的相互作用下自主和在线作出. 同时,随着跟踪物体数量和存储参考文献数量的增长,内存注意的复杂性也随之增加,使得内存效率越来越重要.

blocks.en: We address this with LiAM-SAM ( Fig. 1 ), a Lifecycle-Aware Memory (LiAM) framework built on a detector+SAM2 backbone. The central idea is lifecycle-aware memory integrity: regulate what enters memory at track initialization, maintain memory integrity during interactions, and retain reliable references for long-horizon re-identification. Concretely, LiAM-SAM combines Contrastive Track Initialization (CTI), Motion- and Geometry-Grounded correction (MGG), and Adaptive Context Memory (ACM). We further include Similarity-Aware Spatial Pruning (SASP) as an optional efficiency module that reduces memory-attention cost with limited impact on accuracy.
blocks.zh: 我们用LiAM-SAM(图1)来解决这个问题,这是一个基于探测器+SAM2主干线的生命周期-智能内存(LiAM)框架. 中心思想是生命周期-意识记忆完整性:在轨迹初始化时调节什么进入内存,在相互作用时保持内存完整性,为长视重识别保留可靠的引用. 具体来说,LiAM-SAM结合 对比轨道初始化(CTI),运动和几何方格修正(MGG),以及适应性上下文记忆(ACM). 我们进一步将“类似-Aware Space Pruning”(SASP)作为可选的效率模块,减少内存留念费用,对准确性的影响有限。

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are: • A lifecycle-aware memory-integrity formulation for SAM2-based MOT. We formalize detector-prompted SAM2 tracking as an object-lifecycle memory problem with three main failure stages: track initiation, interaction-time propagation, and reappearance. • A unified method instantiation in LiAM-SAM. We instantiate this formulation with CTI for reliable track initiation, MGG for interaction-time correction, and ACM for robust long-horizon re-identification. • Optional efficiency boost via attention-time pruning. We include SASP, which prunes spatial memory tokens using shared similarity cues to improve runtime while preserving most tracking quality. • Comprehensive empirical validation. On DanceTrack [ 22 ] , BDD100K [ 37 ] and SportsMOT [ 5 ] , LiAM-SAM delivers state-of-the-art performance and large association gains over a detector+SAM2 baseline, including +10.5 HOTA, +17.4 AssA, and 96% fewer ID switches on DanceTrack.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,我们的贡献是:为基于SAM2-MOT的生命周期记忆集成配制。 我们把探测器即时的SAM2跟踪正式确定为一个物体寿命周期内存问题,主要有三个故障阶段:轨道启动、相互作用时间传播和重新出现。 • LiAM-SAM的统一方法即时处理。 我们与CTI一起即兴使用这种配方,以进行可靠的轨道启动,MGG用于交互时间校正,ACM用于强力的长视距重新识别. · 通过注意时间调查提高可选效率。 我们包括SPASP,它利用共享的相似性提示来刷新空间内存符号,以改善运行时间,同时保留大多数跟踪质量. • 全面经验验证。 在DanceTrack [22],BDD100K [37] 和SportsMOT [5]上,LiAM-SAM在探测器+SAM2基线,包括+10.5 HOTA,+17.4 AssA以及DanceTrack上减少96%的ID开关上提供最先进的性能和大型关联收益.

blocks.en: A lifecycle-aware memory-integrity formulation for SAM2-based MOT. We formalize detector-prompted SAM2 tracking as an object-lifecycle memory problem with three main failure stages: track initiation, interaction-time propagation, and reappearance.
blocks.zh: 用于SAM2-基于MOT的生命周期-认知记忆-集成配体. 我们把探测器即时的SAM2跟踪正式确定为一个物体寿命周期内存问题,主要有三个故障阶段:轨道启动、相互作用时间传播和重新出现。

blocks.en: A unified method instantiation in LiAM-SAM. We instantiate this formulation with CTI for reliable track initiation, MGG for interaction-time correction, and ACM for robust long-horizon re-identification.
blocks.zh: 在LiAM-SAM中统一的方法即时化. 我们与CTI一起即兴使用这种配方,以进行可靠的轨道启动,MGG用于交互时间校正,ACM用于强力的长视距重新识别.

blocks.en: Optional efficiency boost via attention-time pruning. We include SASP, which prunes spatial memory tokens using shared similarity cues to improve runtime while preserving most tracking quality.
blocks.zh: 通过注意时间的探测来提高可选效率。 我们包括SPASP,它利用共享的相似性提示来刷新空间内存符号,以改善运行时间,同时保留大多数跟踪质量.

blocks.en: Comprehensive empirical validation. On DanceTrack [ 22 ] , BDD100K [ 37 ] and SportsMOT [ 5 ] , LiAM-SAM delivers state-of-the-art performance and large association gains over a detector+SAM2 baseline, including +10.5 HOTA, +17.4 AssA, and 96% fewer ID switches on DanceTrack.
blocks.zh: 全面经验论证. 在DanceTrack [22],BDD100K [37] 和SportsMOT [5]上,LiAM-SAM在探测器+SAM2基线,包括+10.5 HOTA,+17.4 AssA以及DanceTrack上减少96%的ID开关上提供最先进的性能和大型关联收益.

blocks.en: Figure 1 : LiAM-SAM. Starting from the combination of a detector and SAM2, our method matches bounding boxes and masks and initializes the tracked objects by explicitly presenting to SAM2 negative points— i.e . , other tracked objects overlapping with the new potential one (Contrastive Tracking Initialization). The Adaptive Context Memory (ACM) introduces long memory and is updated only when the appearance is reliable. Finally, Motion & Geometry Grounded correction corrects confusion during occlusions and mask bleeding using motion and depth cues.
blocks.zh: 图1: LiAM-SAM. 从探测器和SAM2的组合开始,我们的方法与捆绑的盒子和面具相匹配,通过向SAM2明确呈现负点来初始化履带物体——即其他履带物体与新的潜在物体重叠(Contrastic Track Improduction). 适应性上下文记忆(ACM)引入长内存,仅在外观可靠时才更新. 最后,运动和几何定位修正用运动和深度提示纠正了隔离期间的混乱和口罩流血。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Detection-Based Online Tracking
blocks.zh: 2.1 基于探测的在线跟踪

blocks.en:
Online multi-object tracking (MOT) methods traditionally follow the tracking-by-detection paradigm, where frame-level detections are associated over time to maintain identities. Early methods such as SORT [ 2 ] rely on Kalman filtering and IoU matching, while DeepSORT [ 27 ] adds appearance embeddings to improve association under ambiguity. Later approaches, including JDE [ 26 ] and FairMOT [ 40 ] , jointly learn detection and identity cues, while ByteTrack [ 39 ] improves robustness by associating both high- and low-confidence detections.
More recent methods such as CenterTrack [ 42 ] and OC-SORT [ 3 ] improve motion continuity: CenterTrack introduces an offset regression branch that predicts displacement vectors between consecutive frames, allowing the tracker to propagate identities without a separate matching stage, while OC-SORT refines Kalman-based updates using observed detection dynamics. Overall, detection-based trackers have evolved from simple motion association toward more integrated and learned propagation schemes.
However, they do not explicitly address the lifecycle of segmentation-based object memory, which becomes critical under long occlusions, re-entry, and close interactions.
blocks.zh:
在线多对象跟踪(MOT)方法传统上遵循逐项跟踪的范式,其中帧级检测在一段时间内被关联起来,以保持身份. SORT[2]等早期方法依靠卡尔曼过滤和IoU匹配,而DeepSORT[27]则增加外观嵌入,在模糊不清的情况下改善关联. 包括JDE[26]和FairMOT[40]在内的后期方法共同学习检测和身份提示,而ByteTrack[39]则通过将高自信检测和低自信检测结合起来来提高稳健性.
CenterTrack[42]和OC-SORT[3]等较新的方法改进了运动连续性:CenterTrack引入了一个抵消回归分支,预测连续帧之间的移位矢量,使得跟踪器可以在没有单独匹配阶段的情况下传播身份,而OC-SORT则利用观测到的检测动态来改进基于卡尔曼的更新. 总体而言,基于检测的跟踪器已从简单的运动关联发展到更加综合和学习的传播计划。
然而,它们没有明确处理基于分化的物体记忆的生命周期问题,在长期隔离、重返和密切的相互作用下,这种记忆变得至关重要。

blocks.en: 2.2 Attention-Based Trackers
blocks.zh: 2.2 注意追踪器

blocks.en: Attention mechanisms have become prominent in modern MOT systems, enabling robust association across frames by selectively focusing on relevant spatial and temporal cues. These approaches leverage attention to unify detection and tracking within transformer-based architectures.
blocks.zh: 关注机制在现代多指标类集技术系统中变得突出,通过有选择地注重相关的空间和时间提示,使跨框架的紧密联系成为可能。 这些方法促使人们注意在基于变压器的架构内统一检测和跟踪。

blocks.en: Parallel approaches (e.g., VisTR [ 25 ] , SeqFormer [ 29 ] ) apply spatiotemporal attention over short video clips in a single pass, enabling joint reasoning across frames. However, this dense attention incurs high memory costs, restricting scalability to longer sequences.
blocks.zh: 平行方法(如VisTR [25], SeqFormer [29])将短视频片段的瞬间注意力应用在单一的通道中,从而可以跨帧联合推理. 然而,这种密集的注意力需要高昂的内存成本,将可伸缩性限制在更长的序列上.

blocks.en: Serial approaches (e.g., TrackFormer [ 17 ] , TransTrack [ 23 ] ) update track queries iteratively, frame by frame. For instance, TransTrack combines attention with IoU-based matching for new detections.
blocks.zh: 串行方法(如TrackFormer [17],TransTrack [23]) 迭代更新跟踪查询,帧逐帧更新. 例如,TransTrack将注意力和基于IoU的匹配结合起来,用于新的检测.

blocks.en:
Recent methods further improve the temporal representation of track queries. ColTrack [ 15 ] retains multiple historical queries for each target to collaboratively refine the current representation, improving robustness to large appearance and displacement changes in low-frame-rate videos. Dual-Path Temporal Decoder [ 12 ] instead separates appearance adaptation from identity preservation through complementary decoder paths and suppresses unreliable query updates based on prediction confidence.
Despite advances in attention-based approaches, the performance is constrained by limited annotated data and reliance on short-range temporal cues.
blocks.zh:
最近的方法进一步改善了轨道查询的时间表现。 ColTrack [15] 为每个目标保留了多个历史查询,以便合作完善目前的表述,提高强度到大型外观,以及低帧率视频的置换变化. Dual-Path Temperal Decoder [12] 转而通过互补的解码路径将外观适应与身份保存区分开来,并压制基于预测自信的不可靠的查询更新.
尽管在基于关注的方法方面取得了进展,但由于附加说明的数据有限和依赖短距离时间提示,业绩受到限制。

blocks.en: 2.3 Large Foundation Models and SAM2
blocks.zh: 2.3 大基础模型和SAM2

blocks.en:
SAM2 [ 20 ] provides strong generalizable video segmentation, making it an attractive backbone for segmentation-driven MOT. Its memory-based architecture stores historical mask-level features encoding appearance and position, supporting identity preservation under occlusions and appearance changes.
Extensions such as SAM2-Long [ 6 ] and SAMURAI [ 33 ] further improve scalability and memory efficiency through hierarchical structures and cleaning strategies.
SAM2MOT [ 11 ] combines open-vocabulary detections with SAM2 segmentation, but relies on offline video-specific hyperparameter optimization, limiting its practicality for online real-world applications.
SAM3 [ 4 ] extends the open-vocabulary MOT (OV-MOT) approach to focus on a more efficient and robust open-vocabulary prompter, while SAM2 remains a strong and flexible baseline to adapt any type of detector for more traditional and critical MOT task with a closed set of categories targets.
blocks.zh:
SAM2 [20] 提供了强烈的泛泛的视频分区,使其成为分块驱动的MOT的有吸引力的骨干. 其基于内存的建筑存储了历史面具级别特征编码的外观和位置,支持在隐蔽和外观变化下的身份保存.
SAM2-Long[6]和SAMURAI[33]等扩展通过等级结构和清洁策略进一步提高可扩展性和内存效率.
SAM2MOT [11] 将开放-vocabulary检测与SAM2分区结合,但依赖于离线视频特有的超参数优化,限制了其对在线现实世界应用的实用性.
SAM3[4]扩展了开放-vobulary MOT(OV-MOT)方法,以侧重于更有效和更强的开放-vobulary提示器,而SAM2仍是一个强而灵活的基线,可以调整任何类型的探测器,用于更传统和关键的MOT任务,并配有一套封闭的类别目标.

blocks.en:
Building on SAM2, we propose LiAM-SAM, a MOT framework that introduces a robust memory-management system to maintain consistent object identities across long sequences, addressing the limitations of short-range attention in prior methods.
Furthermore, we incorporate depth- and motion-grounded cues to resolve occlusions effectively, enabling the tracker to distinguish overlapping objects and recover identities even under severe visual ambiguity.
blocks.zh:
在SAM2的基础上,我们提出LiAM-SAM,这是一个MOT框架,引入了强大的内存管理系统,以在长序列中保持一致的物体身份,解决以往方法中短程关注的局限性.
此外,我们纳入了深度和运动定位提示,以有效解决隔离问题,使跟踪者能够在严重视觉模糊的情况下区分重叠物体和恢复身份。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 概览

blocks.en: An overview of LiAM-SAM is given in Fig. 1 . We consider monocular multi-object tracking with segmentation. At each frame t t with image I t I_{t} , the tracker f θ f_{\theta} outputs a set of instances, each represented by a segmentation mask, a bounding box, and a persistent identity.
blocks.zh: 图1概述了LiAM-SAM。 我们考虑单体多物体的跟踪 与分化。 在每帧 t t 与图像 I t I_{t}, 追踪器 f θ f_{\theta} 输出一组实例, 每个实例都用分块罩, 边框, 以及持续的身份来代表 。

blocks.en: LiAM-SAM builds on a detector + SAM2 tracking loop governed by a Lifecycle-Aware Memory (LiAM). The central idea is lifecycle-aware memory integrity : regulate what enters memory at track initiation, protect memory during close interactions, and retain reliable references for long-horizon re-identification. We instantiate this framework with four modules: (i) Contrastive Track Initialization (CTI) , which initializes new tracks from detector boxes while suppressing duplicate, false, and sub-object initiations; (ii) Adaptive Context Memory (ACM) , a curated bank of reliable, diverse reference observations for robust long-horizon re-identification after disappearances and context evolution; (iii) Motion- and Geometry-Grounded correction (MGG) , which resolves identity ambiguities via motion-grounded occlusion handling and suppresses mask drifting via depth-guided bleeding correction; and (iv) Similarity-Aware Spatial Pruning (SASP) , optional token trimming on SAM2 object memory based on shared feature similarity, which reduces cross-attention cost with minimal accuracy impact.
blocks.zh: LiAM-SAM基于一个探测器+SAM2的跟踪循环,由一个生命周期-智能内存(LiAM)管理. 中心思想是生命周期-意识记忆完整性 : 调节在轨道启动时进入记忆的内容,在近距离相互作用时保护记忆,并保留可靠引用,用于长视线重新识别. 我们以四个模块即时化这一框架:(一) 反向轨道初始化(CTI),从探测器箱中初始化新的轨道,同时抑制重复、虚假和子物体的启动;(二) 适应性背景记忆(ACM),一个可靠、多样的参考观测库,用于在失踪和背景演变后进行强力长距离重新识别;(三) 运动和几何方位修正(MGGG),通过动向屏蔽处理解决身份模糊问题,并通过深度制导的血液校正来抑制遮罩漂移;(四) 类似-Aware空间冲动(SPASP),基于共同特征相似性的SAM2物体记忆的可选标值三进制,这可以减少交叉移取成本,而精确度影响最小。

blocks.en: MOT is especially sensitive to track birth errors: a false, duplicate, or sub-object initiation can propagate for many subsequent frames. Raising the detector confidence threshold improves birth precision but reduces recall. Instead, CTI keeps detector recall high and enforces a contrastive admissibility policy before a new track is accepted.

blocks.en: 3.3 Adaptive Context Memory (ACM)
blocks.zh: 3.3 适应性背景记忆(ACM)

blocks.en: SAM2 predicts masks in subsequent frames using an attention-based decoder conditioned on object memory embeddings. Its short-term memory provides strong temporal continuity, but may become unreliable after long disappearances or context changes (e.g., viewpoint, illumination, or surrounding objects). For each track i i , we use the standard SAM2 short-term memory of temporally encoded tokens from the last K K frames, without modifications.
blocks.zh: SAM2在后续帧中预言口罩使用基于注意力的解码器,以对象内存嵌入为条件. 它的短期记忆提供了很强的时间连续性,但在长期消失或上下文变化(例如观点、照明或周围物体)后可能变得不可靠。 对于每一个音轨i i,我们使用标准SAM2的短期内存,从最后的 K K 帧中以时间编码的符号,无需修改.

blocks.en: ACM complements this with a time-unbounded memory of reliable and diverse reference observations, while remaining compatible with SAM2’s native memory.
blocks.zh: ACM以对可靠和多样的参考观测的无时限记忆来补充这一点,同时与SAM2的本土记忆保持兼容.

blocks.en:
Adaptive context references. SAM2 also retains the first memory timestep without temporal encoding as a static object reference.
ACM replaces this original static reference of SAM2 with a curated bank of reliable, evolving past observations stored without temporal encoding. Matched track observations are promoted to this conditioning-memory set when considered reliable, following an update schedule that encourages diversity across evolving contexts. This leads to a compact set of adaptive references that improves robustness to long disappearances and context changes, while preserving the fine-grained continuity of SAM2 short-term memory.

ACM将SAM2的这个原始静态参考替换为一个由可靠,不断演变的过去观测存储而无时间编码的库. 匹配的轨迹观测在认为可靠时被推广到这个条件-模组,并遵循鼓励不同不断变化的环境多样性的更新时间表。 这导致一套紧凑的适应性参考,在保持SAM2短期记忆的精细延续性的同时,可以提高长期消失和背景变化的稳健性.

blocks.en: At decoding time, the object query jointly attends to: (i) recent SAM2 short-term memory and (ii) the ACM references. The latter acts as a context-aware re-identification support, especially when the most recent short-term memories are missing or corrupted by interactions.

blocks.en: While other works like DAM4SAM [ 24 ] and SAM2‑Long [ 6 ] rely on alternative SAM2‑generated mask proposals to augment their memory banks, our ACM focuses on capturing contextual and modality‑evolving cues, which also broadens its applicability to segmentation backbones that produce only a single mask.

blocks.en: 3.4 Motion- and Geometry-Grounded correction (MGG)
blocks.zh: 3.4 运动和几何组合修正

blocks.en: Even with CTI and ACM, the most critical failure modes arise during strong interactions between similar objects: duplicate hypotheses can co-exist, masks can bleed across boundaries, and corrupted memories propagate identity switches. MGG addresses these cases by grounding interaction handling in motion and depth cues.
blocks.zh: 即使在CTI和ACM中,最关键的失败模式也出现在类似对象之间的强相互作用中:重复的假说可以共存,面具可以跨边界流血,腐败的记忆传播身份交换机. MGG处理这些案件的方式是,在移动和深度提示中定位互动处理。

blocks.en: MGG acts on pairs of tracks with spatial overlap using two complementary modules: motion‑grounded occlusion resolution (identity-level ambiguity) and depth‑guided bleeding correction (pixel-level contamination).
blocks.zh: MGG使用两个互补模块,在有空间重叠的对轨道上进行行为:运动-定位隔离分辨率(身份-级别模糊)和深度-导血校正(像素级污染)。

blocks.en: 3.4.1 Motion-Grounded Occlusion Resolution
blocks.zh: 3.4.1 运动-包围式渗透溶液

blocks.en: When overlaps are strong, the primary question is often not pixel ownership but identity validity : are we observing two distinct colliding objects, or a duplicate hypothesis attached to the same entity? MGG resolves this ambiguity with a motion-grounded occlusion resolver.
blocks.zh: 当重叠强烈时,主要的问题往往不是像素所有权而是身份有效性:我们是否观察到两个截然不同的碰撞对象,还是同一个实体所附带的重复假说? MGG用一个运动基屏蔽解析器来解决这个模糊性.

blocks.en:
For each strongly overlapping pair ( i , j ) (i,j) , we evaluate short-horizon trajectory distinctness from Kalman-filter motion states, using Mahalanobis-normalized separation over a temporal window. This test distinguishes trajectories that converge into an interaction from nearly indistinguishable duplicate behavior.
If the trajectories are non-distinct , MGG treats the pair as duplicates and suppresses the younger track as the less reliable hypothesis. Otherwise, MGG identifies the temporarily unreliable track via score-history degradation, measured as the drop of the current score relative to a recent local baseline. The track with the strongest degradation is selected; if score evidence is inconclusive, MGG falls back to an age-based preference.
The unreliable track persists, but its ambiguous appearance in the current frame is not written to memory: it is excluded from both SAM2 short-term memory and ACM references.
This selective suppression prevents interaction-induced corruption from propagating through memory. If a track is flagged as a confuser in two consecutive frames with the same object, it is considered unrecoverable and aborted to avoid duplicate propagation.
Together, trajectory distinctness, age, and score decay enable stable resolution, whereas scores alone are unreliable.
This motion grounding bears some similarity to SAMURAI’s motion-affinity mechanism [ 33 ] . However, while SAMURAI generates a motion affinity score to accept/reject proposal at individual-object levels, our motion-grounding logic preserves memory integrity by distinguishing duplicates and collisions for multiple objects.

blocks.en: 3.5 Similarity-Aware Spatial Pruning (SASP)
blocks.zh: 3.5 相似性 -- -- 了解空间运行

blocks.en:
Finally, we improve the efficiency of SAM2 cross-attention by retaining only the memory tokens that are most relevant for object decoding.
For each object, SASP keeps tokens from spatial locations inside the predicted mask, as well as tokens from locations with high feature similarity to the object region. These similar locations may correspond to potential confusers and are useful for the decoder to distinguish the target object from visually similar regions. All remaining memory tokens are discarded. The detailed implementation of SASP, together with the theoretical analysis of its complexity reduction, is provided in the supplementary material. Overall, this strategy approximately halves the latency while retaining most of the tracking accuracy.
blocks.zh:
最后,我们通过只保留与对象解码最相关的内存符号来提高SAM2交叉代理的效率.
对于每个物体,SPASP保留来自预测面具内空间位置的代号,以及来自具有高度特征与对象区域相似位置的代号. 这些类似的位置可能与潜在的混淆器相对应,对于解码器将目标对象与视觉类似的区域区分开来是有用的. 所有剩余的内存符号都被丢弃. 补充材料详细介绍了SASP的实施,以及对其复杂性降低的理论分析。 总的来说,这一战略大约将延迟减半,同时保留大部分跟踪准确性。

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets and Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集和计量

blocks.en: Datasets. We evaluate LiAM-SAM on three challenging benchmarks with complementary failure modes. DanceTrack [ 22 ] contains 100 multi-person dance videos (65 train/val, 35 test) with highly similar appearance, non-linear motion, and frequent heavy occlusions, making association quality the dominant challenge. BDD100K-MOT [ 37 ] targets autonomous driving and contains 1,600 videos (1,400 train, 200 val) across weather, lighting, and scene variations, with annotations for eight traffic-relevant categories (pedestrians, riders, cars, trucks, buses, trains, motorcycles, bicycles). SportsMOT [ 5 ] targets multi-object tracking in sports scenarios and contains 240 videos (45 train, 45 val, 150 test) with fast motion, frequent occlusions, and similar appearances, making association particularly challenging.
blocks.zh: 数据集. 我们评价LiAM-SAM以三个具有挑战性的基准作为补充性失败模式. DanceTrack [22] 包含100个多人舞视频(65列火车/val,35次测试),外观高度相似,非线性运动,频繁的重聚,使得关联质量成为主导挑战. BDD100K-MOT [37] 瞄准自主驾驶,包含1,600个视频(1,400辆列车,200 val),横跨天气,照明,场景变异,并附有8个与交通相关的类别(佩戴者,骑手,汽车,卡车,巴士,火车,摩托车,自行车)的说明. SportsMOT [5]瞄准体育场景中的多对象跟踪,包含240个视频(45列火车,45 val,150测试),具有快速运动,频繁的隔离,以及类似的外观,使得关联特别具有挑战性.

blocks.en: Metrics. Our primary metric is HOTA, which balances detection accuracy (DetA) and association accuracy (AssA). We also report MOTA and IDF1 to match common prior reporting for BDD100K-MOT.
blocks.zh: 度量衡. 我们的主要衡量标准是HOTA,它平衡了检测精度(DetA)和关联精度(AssA). 我们还报告MOTA和IDF1, 以配合以往常见的BDD100K-MOT报告。

blocks.en: 4.2 Implementation details
blocks.zh: 4.2 详细执行情况

blocks.en:
We use RF-DETR-L [ 21 ] , initialised with COCO-pretrained weights [ 14 ] , and fine-tune it on the training set of each dataset.
LiAM-SAM itself requires no training: all tracker modules operate with fixed rules and pretrained SAM2.1-large weights, without fine-tuning SAM2 or learning any tracker component. Thus, while the complete detection-and-tracking pipeline uses a dataset-specific detector, the proposed tracker is training-free.
Images are resized to a square resolution of 1120 × 1120 1120\times 1120 for training and inference.
We use UniK3D [ 19 ] for monocular depth prediction in MGG-Depth ( Sec. 3.4.2 ). Depth is inferred at the original frame resolution and down-sampled to 256 × 256 256\times 256 . Support/component statistics are computed on eroded masks, which improves robustness to boundary noise.
blocks.zh:
我们使用RF-DETR-L [21],以COCO预限重量进行备注 [14],并对每个数据集的培训集进行微调.
LiAM-SAM本身不需要培训:所有跟踪器模块都使用固定规则和预先训练的SAM2.1大重量,没有微调SAM2或学习任何跟踪器组件. 因此,虽然完整的探测和跟踪管道使用数据集专用的探测器,但拟议的跟踪器没有培训。
图像大小调整为平方分辨率1120×1120 1120\times 1120,用于培训和推论.
我们使用UniK3D[19]在MGG-深度(第3.4.2条)中进行单极深度预测。 深度在最初的帧分辨率中推断出来,下取样为256×256256\times 256. 支助/组件统计是根据被侵蚀的口罩计算的,这提高了边界噪音的强度。

blocks.en: Detector fine-tuning uses AdamW with effective learning rate LR eff = 1.25 × 10 − 5 \text{LR}_{\text{eff}}=1.25\times 10^{-5} , encoder learning rate LR eff,enc = 2 × 10 − 6 \text{LR}_{\text{eff,enc}}=2\times 10^{-6} , and weight decay WD = 5 × 10 − 2 \text{WD}=5\times 10^{-2} . We train for 10 epochs with physical batch size 4 on DanceTrack and 2 on BDD100K-MOT, with gradient accumulation to an effective batch of 32 samples. We report results on SportsMOT using the same detector and tracking setup.
blocks.zh: 探测器微调使用 AdamW 的有效学习率 LR eff = 1.25 × 10 − 5\ text {LR {\ text {eff\ 1.25\ times 10^{-5},编码器学习率 LR eff,enc = 2 × 10 -6\text {LR → eff,enc}}=-2\times 10^{-6},体重衰减WD = 5× 10 -2\text {WD}=5\times 10^{-2}. 我们在DanceTrack和BDD100K-MOT上对10个具有物理批量尺寸的世纪进行训练,梯度累积到有效批量的32个样本。 我们使用同样的探测器和跟踪装置报告SportsMOT的结果。

blocks.en: Data augmentation includes normalization, random horizontal flip ( p = 0.5 p=0.5 ), multi-scale resizing (long side capped at 1333 pixels, with short-side alternatives 400/500/600), random crops of 384–600 pixels, and final resizing to 1120 1120 . For BDD100K-MOT, we follow the official challenge protocol [ 1 ] and fine-tune the detector using only the MOT train split. For more details see Sec. 11 .
blocks.zh: 数据增强包括正常化,随机水平翻转(p = 0.5 p = 0.5),多尺度重测(长边封顶为1333像素,短边替代品400/500/600),随机作物384-600像素,最终重测为1120 1120. 对于BDD100K-MOT,我们遵循官方的挑战协议[1],并仅使用MOT列车拆分来微调探测器. 详见第11条。

blocks.en: 4.3 Comparison with state-of-the-art methods
blocks.zh: 4.3 与最新方法的比较

blocks.en: DanceTrack (test set). Table 1 reports the main comparison on DanceTrack test. LiAM-SAM achieves the best HOTA (79.55), MOTA (94.33), AssA (72.59), and DetA (87.25) among all listed methods, while remaining competitive in IDF1 (83.6, second only to the offline SAM2MOT with a 0.3 point difference). Relative to the naive SAM2+RF-DETR baseline, LiAM-SAM improves HOTA by +15.25, AssA by +20.49, and reduces identity switches by 96%, showing that the gain is primarily driven by stronger association rather than proposal quality alone.
blocks.zh: DanceTrack (测试集). 表1报告了DanceTrack测试的主要比较。 LiAM-SAM在所有列出的方法中都取得了最好的HOTA(79.55),MOTA(94.33),AssA(72.59)和DetA(87.25),同时在IDF1(83.6,仅次于离线的SAM2MOT,0.3点差)中保持竞争力. 相对于天真的SAM2+RF-DETR基线,LiAM-SAM将HOTA改进为+15.25,AssA改进为+20.49,将身份开关减少96%,表明收益主要由更强大的关联驱动,而不是仅靠提案质量.

Specifically, we use the official fine-tuned YOLOX checkpoint released by ByteTrack, without any additional fine-tuning. Using this detector, LiAM-SAM achieves the best HOTA (76.5), IDF1 (83.3), and AssA (70.6). In particular, it improves over the previous best HOTA by +6.6 points, while increasing IDF1 and AssA by +10.0 and +10.6 points, respectively, indicating that the gains primarily originate from LiAM.

blocks.en: CTI vs. ACM (without DeMo). Both CTI and ACM improve the naive SAM2+RFDETR baseline (A), but they affect the metrics differently. CTI (C) yields a stronger early gain than ACM-only (B), improving HOTA from 68.0 to 71.9 and reducing IDSW by 44.8% (vs. 15.1% for ACM-only). This is consistent with CTI’s role in reducing duplicate and sub-object track births. This confirms that better birth decisions (CTI) and stronger context references (ACM) address different failure modes.
blocks.zh: 结合CTI和ACM. 它们的组合(D)是添加剂:HOTA达到75.7,AssA达到68.2,IDSW下降到13,407(即从基线-A行的36,210减少33%)。 这证实,更好的生育决定(CTI)和更有力的上下文参考(ACM)可以解决不同的失败模式.

blocks.en: MGG-Motion component (Mo): main association gain. Adding the motion component of MGG produces the largest reductions in ID switches across all settings. In rows E/F/G, IDSW drops by 95.0%, 87.8%, and 89.1% relative to their corresponding parent configurations (B/C/D), while AssA increases by +8.4, +9.3, and +4.0, respectively. This pattern highlights that overlap-time duplicate/confuser suppression remains a major source of association error.
blocks.zh: MGG-Motion组件(Mo):主关联收益. 添加MGG的动作组件,可以产生所有设置中ID开关的最大减少. 在E/F/G行中,IDSW相对于相应的母配置(B/C/D)分别下降了95.0%,87.8%和89.1%,而AssA则分别增加了+8.4,+9.3和+4.0. 这种模式突出表明,重叠时间重复/用户压制仍然是关联错误的一个主要原因。

blocks.en:
MGG-Depth component (De): final refinement. Adding the depth component on top of the full CTI+ACM+Mo configuration (G → \rightarrow H) brings a smaller but consistent final gain, improving AssA (72.2 → \rightarrow 72.7) and further reducing IDSW by 2.7%. This matches its intended role as a local mask/memory refinement during moderate overlap, rather than a primary driver of duplicate suppression.
Finally, Table 5 reports the runtime/accuracy trade-off on DanceTrack validation. Adding SASP to LiAM-SAM increases FPS from 5 to 10 for 4 objects and from 2 to 5 for 30 objects (approximately 2.5 × 2.5\times in the crowded case), while preserving 76.3 HOTA, i.e., about 97 % 97\% of the full-model performances. A full runtime analysis is in Supplementary Tab. 7 .

blocks.en: 4.6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 4.6 限制

blocks.en: Although LiAM-SAM shows state-of-the-art performance across datasets, two practical considerations remain. First, its segmentation‑driven memory operations introduce a computational overhead relative to lighter tracking pipelines. SASP provides an initial step toward mitigating this overhead, though additional optimizations would be required to reach real‑time operation in densely crowded scenes. Second, MGG-depth, which relies on RGB‑derived depth estimates, may be affected in scenes where monocular depth inference is particularly unstable. In practice, these factors had limited impact on our results, and the modular design leaves room for further improvements.
blocks.zh: 尽管LiAM-SAM显示的是各数据集的最新性能,但仍有两个实际考虑. 首先,其分区驱动的内存操作采用了相对于较轻的跟踪管道的计算间接费用。 SASP为缓解这一间接费用迈出了第一步,但还需要进行更多的优化,以便在拥挤的场景中实现实时运作。 第二,MGG深度依赖于RGB‐衍生的深度估计,在单一深度推断特别不稳定的场景中可能会受到影响. 在实践中,这些因素对我们的成果影响有限,模块设计为进一步改进留有余地。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented LiAM-SAM, a segmentation-based MOT framework built on a detector+SAM2 backbone and organized with a Lifecycle-Aware Memory (LiAM) framework. The method combines four complementary modules—CTI, ACM, MGG, and SASP—that act on track birth, reference quality, interaction handling, and memory-attention efficiency, respectively.
Across DanceTrack, BDD100K and SportsMOT, the proposed design yields strong improvements over a SAM2+detector baseline and state-of-the-art performance compared to prior methods. The ablation studies clarify the role of each component to the performance.
Overall, LiAM-SAM demonstrates that coupling segmentation‑based models with principled lifecyle-aware memory leads to substantial robustness gains in multi‑object tracking. We believe the modular nature of the framework also offers a flexible foundation for future extensions, including improved long‑range memory mechanisms and richer multi‑modal cues.

我们介绍了LiAM-SAM,这是一个基于分解的MOT框架,它基于一个探测器+SAM2主干线,并用寿命周期-智能记忆(LiAM)框架组织。 该方法结合了四个相辅相成的模块——CTI、ACM、MGG和SASP,它们分别具有轨迹诞生、参考质量、互动处理和内存注意效率。
在整个DanceTrack、BDD100K和SportsMOT中,与以往的方法相比,拟议的设计比SAM2+探测器基线和最新性能有了很大的改进。 废除研究澄清了每个组成部分对业绩的作用。
总体而言,LiAM-SAM表明,基于分块的模型与原则性的生命细胞意识记忆相配合,在多物体跟踪方面产生了巨大的强性。 我们认为,框架的模块化性质也为今后的扩展提供了灵活的基础,包括改进长程记忆机制和更加丰富的多式联运提示。

SASP is the token-pruning stage of LiAM. For each object memory { 𝐦 i , ℓ t } ℓ \{\mathbf{m}_{i,\ell}^{t}\}_{\ell} , it keeps:
(i) tokens on the object itself, and
(ii) tokens in regions visually similar to the object (likely confusers).

blocks.en: 9 Runtime Analysis
blocks.zh: 9 运行时间分析

blocks.en:
We report measured runtimes of LiAM-SAM on DanceTrack validation sequences using an NVIDIA A100 GPU. Table 7 provides a per-module latency breakdown across different configurations and numbers of tracked objects. This analysis complements the runtime/accuracy trade-off reported in the main paper by isolating the cost of the detector, SAM2, and the individual LiAM components.
Results show that runtime is dominated by SAM2, especially as the number of tracked objects increases. This confirms that memory-based cross-attention is the primary computational bottleneck. In a crowded scenario with 30 tracked objects, SAM2 component accounts for the largest share of the total latency (77.3%), motivating the need for memory-token reduction.
SASP directly targets this bottleneck by pruning spatial memory tokens before cross-attention. As shown in Table 7 , SASP reduces SAM2 latency by approximately 72% in the 30-object setting, while introducing only a small additional pruning overhead. This behavior is consistent with the FLOP-level analysis in Sec. 8 , where reducing the number of retained memory tokens directly lowers the attention cost.
The remaining LiAM components introduce limited overhead relative to SAM2. CTI is negligible, while ACM and bookkeeping scale moderately with the number of active tracks. MGG-motion remains inexpensive and is retained in the fast configuration because it provides the main association benefit. MGG-depth introduces additional cost due to depth estimation and mask refinement, but it is applied selectively and can be disabled when efficiency is prioritized.
Compared with recent transformer-based MOT methods such as ColTrack and DualTemporalMOT, LiAM-SAM operates under a different tracking paradigm that explicitly propagates object masks through SAM2. While this design achieves substantially higher tracking accuracy on both DanceTrack and SportsMOT, as shown in Table 8 , it also incurs a lower processing speed and a larger model size than these detector-based MOT approaches. The latency breakdown in Table 7 shows, however, that most of this overhead originates from SAM2 itself, while the proposed LiAM components contribute only a small fraction of the total runtime.
blocks.zh:
我们用一个NVIDIA A100 GPU来报告LiAM-SAM的运行时间。 表7按不同构型和履带物体数量分列了每个模块的空档。 这项分析通过隔离探测器SAM2和单体LiAM组件的成本,补充了主要文件中报告的运行时间/准确度权衡。
结果显示,运行时间以SAM2为主,尤其是随着跟踪物体数量的增加. 这证实了基于内存的交叉关注是主要的计算瓶颈. 在30个跟踪物体的拥挤情景中,SAM2组件占暂时性总数的最大份额(77.3%),促使需要减少内存。
SPASP直接针对这个瓶颈,在交叉注意前通过浏览空间内存符号. 如表7所示,SPASP在30个对象的设定中将SAM2的延迟度减少约72%,同时只引入一个小的附加挤压性高空. 这种行为与Sec. 8中的FLOP级分析一致,其中减少保留内存符号的数量直接降低注意力成本.
其余的LiAM组件引入了相对于SAM2的有限间接费用. CTI可忽略不计,而ACM和簿记则与活动音轨的数量相比适度. MGG-motion仍然价格低廉,并保留在快速配置中,因为它提供了主要的关联利益. MGG深度引入了由于深度估计和遮掩完善而增加的成本,但这种成本有选择性地应用,在优先考虑效率时可以禁用.
与ColTrack和DualTemporalMOT等基于变压器的MOT方法相比,LiAM-SAM在不同的跟踪模式下运行,通过SAM2明确传播对象口罩. 如表8所示,这种设计在DanceTrack和SportsMOT上的跟踪精度都大大提高,但也比这些基于探测器的MOT方法的处理速度低一些,模型尺寸更大。 然而,表7中不定期的细目表明,这些间接费用大多来自SAM2本身,而拟议的LiAM组件只占总运行时间的一小部分。

blocks.en: Overall, the latency breakdown supports the efficiency design of LiAM-SAM: lifecycle-aware memory control improves association robustness with moderate overhead, while SASP mitigates the dominant SAM2 memory-attention cost in crowded scenes.
blocks.zh: 总体来说,潜伏性分解支持LiAM-SAM的效率设计:生命周期感知内存控制可以提高关联稳健性,同时具有中度的俯冲性,而SASP则可以缓解在拥挤场景中占主导地位的SAM2内存留费.

blocks.en: For each benchmark, we fine-tune the detector prior to tracking evaluation. Model selection is performed using the Exponential Moving Average (EMA) model, and the checkpoint achieving the highest validation Average Precision (AP) is subsequently used for all experiments on the corresponding dataset. For SportsMOT, detector training includes an additional hard-negative fine-tuning stage. Hard negatives are detections with confidence scores greater than or equal to 0.70 and a maximum Intersection over Union (IoU) below 0.10 with any ground-truth annotation. For all datasets, inference uses a detection confidence threshold of 0.30. Table 9 summarizes the complete training and model-selection protocols.
